03 / RESPONSERecommend an actionPeople decide and act
Possible connection

Graph snapshots and diffs could add context to incident assistance. Critical events are selected summaries; graph diffs describe graph changes.

Paper evaluation

Eight Azure outages: five for development and memory, three held out. The authors report 71.4% precision and 52.8–54.8% recall for recommendations.

    Correspondences connect workloads to services or trial epochs.

    Two independent transformations

    Each uses source, correspondence and target graphs. Four workloads map to a service; eight map to an epoch using supplied context.

    What the timeline shows

    A workload dependency becomes a service dependency. The final event changes a signal and updates the affected service.

    What TGG adds

    TGG rules describe consistent graph triples. Derived rules can synchronize changes; direction, conflict handling and implementation depend on the rule system.
